description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing resource information entities in a SQL database, including custom query methods for resource retrieval and existence checks.

classes.name: TbResourceInfoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for TbResourceInfoEntity with custom query methods.

methods.name: findAllTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of resource info entities filtered by tenant ID, resource types, subtypes, and optional search text, considering system tenant fallback.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of resource info entities for a specific tenant, filtered by resource types, subtypes, and optional search text.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndResourceTypeAndResourceKey
methods.description: Finds a resource info entity by tenant ID, resource type, and resource key.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndResourceTypeAndResourceKey
methods.description: Checks if a resource exists with the specified tenant ID, resource type, and resource key.

methods.name: findKeysByTenantIdAndResourceTypeAndResourceKeyStartingWith
methods.description: Finds resource keys starting with a given prefix for a tenant and resource type.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEtagAndResourceKeyStartingWith
methods.description: Finds resource info entities by tenant ID, etag, and resource key prefix.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourceByEtag
methods.description: Retrieves a resource info entity by tenant ID, resource type, and etag, considering system or tenant scope.

methods.name: existsByResourceTypeAndPublicResourceKey
methods.description: Checks if a public resource exists for a given resource type and public resource key.

methods.name: findByResourceTypeAndPublicResourceKeyAndIsPublicTrue
methods.description: Finds a public resource info entity by resource type and public resource key.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourcesByIdIn
methods.description: Retrieves resource info entities by a list of resource IDs, filtered by tenant or system tenant.
